verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird has a dedicated Privacy and Data Protection practice page documenting 130+ lawyers, 25 years' experience, and staff who are former regulators (Irish DPC, CNIL), plus a published GDPR compliance guide and free-to-use SCC Generator tool for EU cross-border transfer agreements. This directly evidences a documented privacy/cyber practice counseling on GDPR compliance. Missing for 10: explicit named coverage of CCPA or India's DPDP Act, and independent corroboration (e.g., rankings/directories) beyond the firm's own site.
